WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Guide to the live game, 1 to 60. Spell and talent figures come from Blizzard's posts and the client with its hotfixes. Talent builds are the guide sites' own, named and dated November 4; the tree has not changed since. Rotations are the ones Wowhead, Icy Veins and WoWSims' model publish for level 60. Nothing here rests on a raid log: no raid opens until December 9. Talent levels assume no TalentedTalentedTalentCastInstantYou gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points. Legacy perk, which starts your points up to five levels earlier without raising the 51-point cap. ClassicWoW.gg's Elemental page is still beta text that describes Lava Burst, so it is not used. Spell tooltips read the base game client and can lag a hotfix, so where one differs from the text here, trust the text.

What Elemental is for

Cleave and area damage at range, with burst on a cooldown. Chain LightningChain LightningLevel 32 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 4Cast2.5 sec castCost245 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownHurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 208 to 236 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets. hits three targets from level 32. Fire NovaFire NovaLevel 12 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost65 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownInstantly inflicts 32 to 38 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem. bursts around your Fire totem from level 12. Lightning MasteryLightning MasteryTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration15 secGain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts 15 sec. at 40 takes 0.5 seconds off Lightning BoltLightning BoltLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost15 ManaRange30 yd rangeCasts a bolt of lightning at the target for 15 to 18 Nature damage. and removes Chain Lightning's cooldown for 15 seconds.

The sources agree single-target damage is its weak side. Wowhead: "So far Elemental appears poised to be a strong Cleave and AoE DPS, but a fairly mediocre Single Target DPS." Icy Veins: "Unfortunately Elemental is rather weak in single-target compared to most other caster options". Icy Veins rates it 3 of 5 overall, 3 for levelling, 3.5 for dungeons and 4.5 for utility and mobility; a levelling score measures solo kill speed.

Mana is the other limit. Wowhead's levelling page: Elemental "struggles with high Mana costs that require support from the other two trees while leveling." Every published build below spends points in Restoration or Enhancement for that reason.

Your power sits on gear more than it did in Classic. Blizzard's November 2 notes set each rank of Lightning BoltLightning BoltLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost15 ManaRange30 yd rangeCasts a bolt of lightning at the target for 15 to 18 Nature damage. to "roughly 78% of the base damage as the Classic Era version (but cast time is lower than Classic Era)", with the Shocks at Classic's values. An Elemental Shaman in stale gear loses more than a Classic one did (ours, not a source's).

Wowhead recommends not levelling as a caster at all. Its levelling page calls a melee hybrid built in the Enhancement tree "the strongest way to level as a Shaman if you're willing to play a hybrid role", and respecs to Elemental later. That advice is dated November 4 and leans on Intellect through Mental DexterityMental DexterityTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect., which Blizzard cut from 150% to 100% on November 12. See Enhancement.

Why this order. Figures are the client's rank values before gear and talents (our arithmetic).

  • Lightning BoltLightning BoltLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost15 ManaRange30 yd rangeCasts a bolt of lightning at the target for 15 to 18 Nature damage. is your Mana spell. At level 32, Bolt rank 6 deals 144 to 162 for 110 Mana. Chain LightningChain LightningLevel 32 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 4Cast2.5 sec castCost245 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownHurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 208 to 236 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets. rank 1 deals 208 to 236 to its first target for 245 Mana, on the same 2.5-second cast. That is Blizzard's design: about 145% of the Bolt's damage for about 225% of its Mana. On one target Chain Lightning is damage you pay extra for, which is why all three sources gate it on Mana or a free cast.
  • Spend Clearcasting on the expensive spell. Elemental FocusElemental FocusTalentCastInstantGives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%. makes your next damage spell free. A proc saves 245 Mana on Chain Lightning and 110 on that Bolt.

Lasts 15 sec. on one target. Stat priority

The two guide sites publish different lists, and both are dated November 4.

Wowhead:

  1. Spell Piercing
  2. Haste
  3. Hit, to 17%
  4. Spell Damage
  5. Critical strike
  6. Intellect, then Spirit

Icy Veins:

  1. Spell Power
  2. Hit, to 17%
  3. Critical strike
  4. Intellect
  5. MP5

They agree on Hit and Spell Power and differ on Spell Piercing and Haste, which Icy Veins does not list. WoWSims' weights side with Wowhead: per point of Spell Damage, Spell Piercing 1.81, Haste 1.23, Hit 1.18, critical strike 0.61, Intellect 0.19 (WoWSims' model, at 60). Spell Piercing is Forever's new stat. It lowers the target's resistance, and Wowhead puts 10 points against an unresisting target at about 1.8% damage at 60.

Hit cap. A raid boss three levels above you is missed 17% of the time. Tidal FocusTidal FocusTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantReduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%. 5/5 supplies 5% of that, leaving 12% from gear. Dwarves get another 1% from Artisan's PrecisionArtisan's PrecisionTalentCastInstantIncreases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1%..

While levelling, Wowhead's short version is Spell Power for damage, Intellect for the pool and Spirit for regeneration, with Hit, critical strike and Spell Piercing "extremely strong, but less common" on low-level gear.

At level 60

Sourced: the builds and priority lists above. Wowhead describes the raid role as support first: "offering strong utility to a raid group instead of strong damage." Not known: how any of it measures up in a raid. None opens until December 9, so no raid log exists. Wowhead reports a developer interview in which Kris Zierhut said of Shaman talents: "I wouldn't be surprised if early next year we revisit Shaman talents a little bit. It's not going to be sooner than that." That is Wowhead's account of an interview, not a Blizzard post.
